inline_text:
Related to #30

## Scope

Reference Architectures only:

- `workstreams/reference-architectures/`

## What

Replace “step” terminology with “activity” in reference architecture documents, patterns, templates, and supporting material.

## Why

The working group agreed to use “Activity” instead of “Step”.
This aligns the Reference Architectures workstream with the taxonomy.

The separate `Execution engine` / `Workflow lifecycle` terminology proposal is not included.
